title: Agentic Walkthrough Verdict
description: Structured output the walkthrough-runner subagent produces after exercising a goal's acceptance criteria in a live browser (Playwright). Generated only for UI-touching goals; non-UI goals skip with verdict: skipped.

verdict.description: clean=all criteria pass; concern=some criteria fail or console errors present; blocking=critical failure (dev server didn't start, page crashed, etc.); skipped=non-UI goal or walkthrough not configured

skip_reason.description: Populated only when verdict=skipped. Examples: 'no walkthrough section in spec', 'dev_server_command not configured and no server detected at acceptance_url'.

dev_server.description: Populated when verdict != skipped. Describes the dev-server context the walkthrough used.

criterion.description: The natural-language criterion verbatim from the spec's Walkthrough section.

evidence.description: What the runner observed: URL it landed on, text it saw, screenshot path, etc.

screenshot_path.description: Relative path under .claude/agentic/walkthrough-screenshots/<goal-id>/, if a screenshot was captured for this criterion.

console_errors_count.description: Browser console errors observed during the walkthrough. Non-zero contributes to verdict=concern.

console_errors_sample.description: First 10 distinct error messages (capped to avoid bloating the verdict file).
